title: One-Step Unfolding of the Bridging Machine
statement: For every partial-recursive program $c$, bridge-alphabet word $x$, valid input-head position $p$, stack assignment $st$, output word $out$, and bridging-machine control state $q$, one step from the bridge configuration determined by $q,p,st,out$ equals the result of applying the bridging machine's transition action for $q$, the symbol under the input head, and the symbols under the four work-tape heads to that configuration.
replaced:
One step of the bridging machine from a bridge configuration in a live control state
is computed by applying the action that its transition table prescribes for that
state, the symbol under the input head, and the symbols under the four work-tape
heads.
